articles.title_en: Surviving Bad News: Health Information without Treatment Options
articles.title_cn: 在坏消息中生存：无治疗选项的健康信息
articles.abstract_en: When there is no treatment available for a life-threatening disease, providing personal health information could lead to despair or fatalistic behaviors resulting in negative health outcomes. We document this possibility utilizing an experiment in Malawi that randomized incentives to learn HIV testing results in a context where antiretroviral treatment was not yet available. Six years after the experiment, among HIV-positive individuals, those who learned their status were 23 percentage points less likely to survive than those who did not, with effects persisting after 15 years. Receiving an HIV-positive diagnosis resulted in riskier health behaviors, greater anxiety, and higher discount rates. (JEL D83, D91, I12, I18, O12)
articles.abstract_cn: 当一种危及生命的疾病没有可用的治疗方法时，提供个人健康信息可能导致绝望或宿命论行为，从而产生负面健康结果。我们利用马拉维的一项实验记录了这种可能性，该实验在抗逆转录病毒治疗尚不可用的背景下，随机分配了了解HIV检测结果的激励措施。实验六年后，在HIV阳性个体中，那些了解自己状况的人比未了解的人存活可能性低23个百分点，这种影响在15年后仍然持续。接受HIV阳性诊断导致了更冒险的健康行为、更高的焦虑和更高的贴现率。(JEL D83, D91, I12, I18, O12)

articles.title_en: When Big Data Enables Behavioral Manipulation
articles.title_cn: 当大数据实现行为操纵时
articles.abstract_en: We build a model of online behavioral manipulation driven by AI advances. A platform dynamically offers one of n products to a user who slowly learns product quality. User learning depends on a product’s “glossiness,” which captures attributes that make products appear more attractive than they are. AI tools enable platforms to learn glossiness and engage in behavioral manipulation. We establish that AI benefits consumers when glossiness is short-lived. In contrast, when glossiness is long-lived, behavioral manipulation reduces user welfare. Finally, as the number of products increases, the platform can intensify behavioral manipulation by presenting more low-quality, glossy products. (JEL C55, D83, D91, L86)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个由人工智能进步驱动的在线行为操纵模型。平台动态地向一个缓慢学习产品质量的用户提供n种产品之一。用户学习取决于产品的“光泽度”，这捕捉了使产品看起来比实际更具吸引力的属性。人工智能工具使平台能够学习光泽度并进行行为操纵。我们确定，当光泽度短暂存在时，人工智能对消费者有利。相反，当光泽度长期存在时，行为操纵会降低用户福利。最后，随着产品数量的增加，平台可以通过提供更多低质量、高光泽度的产品来加强行为操纵。（JEL C55, D83, D91, L86）

articles.title_en: Money (Not) to Burn: Payments for Ecosystem Services to Reduce Crop Residue Burning
articles.title_cn: 金钱（不）燃烧：减少作物秸秆焚烧的生态系统服务付费
articles.abstract_en: We test whether payments for ecosystem services (PES) can curb the highly polluting practice of crop residue burning in India. Standard PES contracts pay participants after verification that they met a proenvironment condition (clearing fields without burning). We randomize paying a portion of the money up front and unconditionally to address liquidity constraints and farmer distrust, which may undermine the standard contract’s effectiveness. Incorporating partial up-front payment into the contract increases compliance by 10 percentage points, which is corroborated by satellite-based burning measurements. The cost per life saved is $3,600–$5,400. The standard PES contract has no effect on burning. (JEL D86, O13, Q12, Q15, Q18, Q53, Q58)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们测试生态系统服务付费（PES）是否能遏制印度高度污染的作物秸秆焚烧行为。标准的PES合同在验证参与者满足环保条件（不清烧而清理田地）后支付款项。我们随机将部分款项提前无条件支付，以解决流动性约束和农民不信任问题，这些问题可能削弱标准合同的有效性。将部分预付款纳入合同使合规率提高了10个百分点，这得到了基于卫星的焚烧测量的证实。每条挽救生命的成本为3,600至5,400美元。标准的PES合同对焚烧没有影响。（JEL D86, O13, Q12, Q15, Q18, Q53, Q58）

articles.title_en: Does Turnover Inhibit Specialization? Evidence from a Skill Survey in Peru
articles.title_cn: 人员流动是否抑制了专业化？来自秘鲁技能调查的证据
articles.abstract_en: We design, pilot, and field a new survey of job skills in Peru to investigate human capital differences between poor and rich countries. Peruvian jobs have markedly more uniform skill profiles than jobs in the United States. On the other hand, matching frictions are no more severe than in the United States, and recruiting technology is largely equivalent as well. We propose a stylized model in the O-ring tradition, in which a labor demand preference for unspecialized workers can endogenously arise when there is uncertainty about labor availability. (JEL J22, J23, J24, J41, J46, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们设计、试点并实地开展了一项针对秘鲁工作技能的新调查，以研究穷国与富国之间的人力资本差异。秘鲁的工作技能画像比美国的工作更为统一。另一方面，匹配摩擦并不比美国更严重，招聘技术也大体相当。我们提出了一个基于O型环传统的简化模型，在该模型中，当劳动力供给存在不确定性时，对非专业化工人的劳动需求偏好可以内生地产生。(JEL J22, J23, J24, J41, J46, O15)

articles.title_en: Promotions and Productivity: The Role of Meritocracy and Pay Progression in the Public Sector
articles.title_cn: 晋升与生产率：公共部门中的任人唯贤与薪酬递进的作用
articles.abstract_en: We study promotion incentives in the public sector. In collaboration with Sierra Leone’s Ministry of Health, we introduce exogenous variation in the meritocratic nature of promotions from health worker to supervisor positions and in health workers’ perceptions of pay progression upon promotion. Ten months later, our findings reveal that meritocracy leads to a 22 percent increase in health workers’ productivity. Greater perceived pay progression in a meritocratic system boosts productivity by 23 percent, whereas in a less meritocratic system, it decreases productivity by 27 percent. We show that this reduction is consistent with a negative morale effect. (JEL C93, H51, I11, J24, J31, M51, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究公共部门的晋升激励。与塞拉利昂卫生部合作，我们在从卫生工作者晋升至主管职位的任人唯贤性质以及卫生工作者对晋升后薪酬递进的感知中引入了外生变异。十个月后，我们的研究结果显示，任人唯贤导致卫生工作者的生产率提高了22%。在任人唯贤的体系中，更高的感知薪酬递进使生产率提高了23%，而在较不任人唯贤的体系中，它却使生产率降低了27%。我们表明，这种降低与消极士气效应一致。(JEL C93, H51, I11, J24, J31, M51, O15)

articles.title_en: Induced Innovation, Inventors, and the Energy Transition
articles.title_cn: 诱导创新、发明人与能源转型
articles.abstract_en: We study how individual inventors respond to incentives to work on “clean” electricity technologies. Using natural gas price variation, we estimate output and entry elasticities of inventors and measure the medium-term impacts of a price increase mirroring the social cost of carbon. We find that the induced clean innovation response primarily comes from existing clean inventors. New inventors are less responsive on the margin than their average contribution to clean energy patenting would indicate. Our results strengthen the rationale for government intervention to expedite the energy transition. (JEL L94, O31, O34, Q35, Q42, Q55)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究个体发明人如何响应从事“清洁”电力技术的激励。利用天然气价格变动，我们估计了发明人的产出和进入弹性，并衡量了反映碳社会成本的价格上涨的中期影响。我们发现，诱导的清洁创新响应主要来自现有的清洁发明人。新发明人在边际上的响应程度低于其平均贡献于清洁能源专利所显示的水平。我们的结果加强了政府干预以加速能源转型的理由。（JEL L94, O31, O34, Q35, Q42, Q55）

articles.title_en: The High-Frequency Effects of Dollar Swap Lines
articles.title_cn: 美元互换额度的高频效应
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of dollar swap lines using high-frequency responses in asset prices around policy announcements. News about expanded dollar swap lines causes a reduction in liquidity premia, compression of deviations from covered interest parity, and depreciation of the dollar. Equity prices rise and the VIX falls, while the response of long-term government bond prices is mixed. The cross section of high-frequency responses implies that swap lines affect the dollar factor or the price of risk. Our findings are qualitatively consistent with models relating the supply of dollar liquidity to the broader economy. (JEL E43, E44, E58, F31, G12, G13, G15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用政策公告期间资产价格的高频反应来研究美元互换额度的效应。关于扩大美元互换额度的消息导致流动性溢价下降，抵补利率平价偏差收窄，以及美元贬值。股票价格上涨，VIX指数下跌，而长期政府债券价格的反应则不一。高频反应的横截面表明，互换额度影响美元因子或风险价格。我们的发现在性质上与将美元流动性供给与更广泛经济联系起来的模型一致。(JEL E43, E44, E58, F31, G12, G13, G15)

articles.title_en: Community Engagement with Law Enforcement after High-Profile Acts of Police Violence
articles.title_cn: 高曝光警察暴力事件后社区与执法部门的互动
articles.abstract_en: We document a sharp rise in gunshots coupled with declining 911 call volume across 13 major US cities in the aftermath of the murder of George Floyd. National survey data also indicate that victims of crime became less likely to report their victimization to law enforcement due to mistrust of police. Our results suggest that high-profile acts of police violence may erode community engagement with law enforcement and highlight the call-to-shot ratio as a natural measure of attitudes toward the police. (JEL H76, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了在乔治·弗洛伊德被杀后，美国13个主要城市的枪声显著增加，同时911报警电话数量下降。全国调查数据也表明，犯罪受害者因对警察的不信任而报告受害情况的意愿降低。我们的结果表明，高曝光的警察暴力行为可能会削弱社区与执法部门的互动，并强调报警与枪声比率作为衡量对警察态度的自然指标。(JEL H76, K42)
